notes.title: Kaz's Adventure 2: Lost Souls News!
notes.content:
[i]First of all thank you to all the feedback for the base game that has been shared via reviews on the store page and via YouTube videos, In Kaz's Adventure 2: Lost Souls I've used everyone's feedback to improve the quality and enjoyment that can be had from the game.[/i]

[i]In the sequel you'll be adventuring through the underworld as Kaz searches to reunite with his brother and along the way you'll be able to speak with NPCs, I'm also happy to announce that their won't be any floaty physics, this game will also have a new art style and more character animations then before.[/i]

[i]Kaz's Adventure 2: Lost Souls will feature 4 worlds to explore with 8 levels and completely new environments with planned extra levels and special bonus worlds being added post launch, this will also be the last Kaz game as I focus on new projects for everyone to enjoy, there is a chance Kaz can return but for now this game will feature the end to his particular story.[/i]

[i]This game has been in the works for along time and on June 17th we will be releasing the final trailer before its release in Q4 2024 for free here on steam.[/i]

notes.title: Kaz's Adventure | Content Support Ending!
notes.content:
[u][b]Kaz's Adventure's Support Is Now Ending, But Why?[/b][/u]

[i]Kaz's Adventure Has More Then Double The Amount Of Content It Had From Launch And We Think Now Is A Good Time To Focus On Future Projects And Kaz's Adventure 2, The Systems I Created For The Game Our Insanely Rough To Work With Because Of My Limited Knowledge At The Time And Making Content Is Becoming More Costly And Time Consuming In The Process, Therefore We Are Cutting Content Support, Bug Fixes And New Console Commands May Be Added Here And There But New Content In General Wont Be Added![/i]

[u][b]Will There Be Anymore Updates?[/b][/u]

[i]Yes! Future Bug Fixes And Console Commands Are Coming, For The Seeable Future Non Content Related Updates Are Still Happening![/i]

[u][b]How Long Will Kaz's Adventure 2's Support Last?[/b][/u]

[i]Currently It's Support Length Is Unknown Due To It Being Still in Development But I Can Confirm It Will Have At Least 1 Major Update And 1 Free Story Expansion DLC At The Minimum![/i]

[u][b]Dev Thank You Note![/b][/u]

[i]Since 2019 Kaz's Adventure Has Been In Some Kind Of Development And When We Released The Game In September 2022 I Had A Unexpected Reponse, Somehow People Liked My First Ever Game.

Although It Being My First Ever Game Shows Especially Looking Back On It Compared To Kaz's Adventure 2, The Stuff I Learnt And The Feedback And Youtube Videos Of The Games I Saw Was Amazing And Heart Warming To See And The Feedback Made Me Push Myself Harder And Learn New Things Such As Better Coding And Level Design.

I Can't Thank You Enough For Playing Kaz's Adventure And Honestly Can't Wait To Show You Kaz's Adventure 2: Lost Souls And Other Future Projects Like Physics Lab!

- Harlow[/i]

[b][u]Check Out Kaz's Adventure 2: Lost Souls Here:[/u] [/b]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2147030/Kazs_Adventure_2_Lost_Souls/

notes.title: Kaz's Adventure | Major Update #3 - New Hardcore & Survival Modes!
notes.content:
[u][b]What's New![/b][/u]

[i]In This Update Tweaks Have Been Made To Have The Game Running Better Then Ever Before, We Have Also Added A Hardcore Mode Which Was Requested Quite A Lot, By Completing Hardcore Mode You Gain A Achievement But If You Die In Hardcore Mode You Restart The Entire Mode![/i]

[i]A New Survival Mode Has Been Added, This Mode Has Been Ported Over From Kaz's Adventure 2: Lost Souls And Has You On A Small Platform Where You Must Survive As Long As Possible, This Mode Is A More Simple Version Of Kaz 2's Mode, In This Version Enemies Are 10x Easier To Dodge But It Still Can Be Some Fun![/i]

[i]New Quality Of Life Updates Have Also Been Made, There's Now An Extra Option To Lock Your FPS To 30 And A Dev Console Has Been Added For Those Who Want To Skip Parts Of The Game If They So Choose, Kaz's Physics Have Also Been Slightly Tweaked To Make Him More Easier To Control And Feel Overall More Polished, We Can't Majorly Change His Physics Due To It Requiring A Rework Of Many Levels![/i]

[i]As Many Know, Major Update #3 Will Be Kaz's Adventure's Last Major Update With Content Support Ending With This Updates Release, Future Updates Will Purely Be Bug Fixes And Maybe A Few Dev Console Commands But Overall This Is The Last Content Filled Update, We Thank You For Playing Kaz's Adventure And Look Forward To Showing You Kaz's Adventure 2: Lost Souls In November This Year![/i]

[u][b]Kaz's Adventure | Major Update #3 {Update Notes}[/b][/u]

- New Hardcore Mode (Available After Obtaining First Jar)
Play Kaz's Adventure Again But With A Evil Twist, Kaz Only Has One Chance And If You Die Even Once 
You Have To Restart From The First Level Of The Game, Beating This Mode Unlocks A 4th Save Star And A Secret Achievement!

- New Survival Mode (Available After Obtaining 75 Jars)
Survive As Long As You Can On A Short Platform And Gain New High Scores In This New Mode Ported From Kaz's Adventure 2: Lost Souls

- New FPS Lock Mode
The New Classic Mode In Settings Makes Your FPS Locked At 30 FPS, This Can Also Be A Way To Help With Frame Drops Or Unstable FPS If Your Having Issues Running The Game

- Confirmation For Save Deletion
A New Menu Pops Up Which Will Ask You To Confirm To Delete Your Save Rather Then Just Instantly Delete Your Save

- New Dev Console
A Dev Console Has Been Added And Is Only Accessible Through The Main Menu, Not Clicking To Start Or Going Into A Level Or Sub Menu Will Not Allow The Console To Open, Future Commands Will Be Added At A Later Date And The Command List Can Be Found In Our Discord Server's Forums Channel Under Kaz's Adventure And Dev News Tags

- New Lighting Quality Setting {Medium > High}
- Tweaked Particle Effects For Kaz's Death & Respawn Effect

- Aspect Ratio's 5:4 & 16:10 Are No Longer Supported
- Fixed Enemy On DLC Level 5 Not Dying
- Fixed Some UI Issues With 1280x800 Displays
- Tweaked Audio Volumes For Menu And Level Themes

notes.title: Kaz's Adventure | Small Patch {V1.2.1}

[i][b]Hi, A New Small Patch Is Out Which Heavily Improves The Base Game, DLC And Kaz FE's Overall Experience And Quality, This Patch Fixes A Few Technical Issues Such As UI Not Being In The Right Places And Levels Not Finishing Or Giving Achievements, There's Also Quality Of Life Changes Such As Weather Now Not Freezing During The Game Being Paused![/b][/i]

[i][b]In Terms Of The Final Major Update, Major Update 3 Hasn't Started Development Yet, At The Moment I'm Just Planning What I'm Going To Do For The Final Update, I'm Currently Thinking Of Adding A New Game Mode And Possibly A Hardcore Mode, I Also Want To Update The Camera System Like Locking The Y Axis And Update The Particle Effect For Kaz's Respawn And Death, Also The Idea Of A Online Multiplayer Mode Like A Battle Mode Or Something Was Thought About But Currently That's Unlikely Due To Me Having No Knowledge Of Online Multiplayer In Unity And It Wouldn't Fit The Games Design Although That Doesn't Mean It's Out Of The Question For Future Projects Or Kaz Games Just Not Anytime Soon, None Of The Stuff I'm Thinking Of At The Moment Are Promises But There Is A Possibility It Could Happen, The 3rd Major Update Will Most Likely Be A Q2 2023 Release![/b][/i]

notes.title: Kaz's Adventure | Major Update #1 Details
notes.content:
[u][b]Kaz's Adventure | Major Update #1 Details[/b][/u]

Since Kaz's Adventure Started Development One Of The Main Questions Was If Multiplayer Could Work, And Although Story Wise It Wouldn't Work For That, A Partially Canon Side Story Could!

Set In-Between Kaz's Adventure 1 And 2, Kaz Travels Through The City Of Zolta, A City Which Looks Similar To Our Modern Day Ones, Kaz Will Have No Boss Fight For This Journey But Will Have 6 Levels To Play Through With New Tiles And Backgrounds And 1 New Enemy, Kaz's CO-OP Partner Will Be A Kaz Shadow Which Cannot Be Harmed By Enemy's Only Fall Damage And Cannot Run Or Attack, Kaz Can Do All His Moves Though!

Although Local CO-OP Is Not Ideal For All Players Due To Circumstances Meaning Friends Aren't Near Enough To Play On The Same Keyboard, Steams Remote Play Together Will Help All Players Be Able To Play This New Mode And If Want A Better Experience Player 1 Can Play With Controller Meaning Player 2 Can Have All The Space To Use His Original Side Of His Keyboard! 

Although This New World Exclusive To Local CO-OP, You Can Play It By Yourself And Either Push Or Leave Behind Your Shadow And Play The Adventure Solo Although It's Heavily Not Recommended As It's Designed For 2 Players So Certain Levels May Not Be Beatable But Most Should!

The Update Also Includes UI And Gameplay Fixes Such As Spelling And Sprite Issues!

This Update Should Release Sometime Early November But At Most Mid November!

notes.title: New World System - Important
notes.content:
[h1]New World Ordering And System[/h1]
[h2]New World 2: Beach / Sea Themed[/h2]

[b][u]What Is The New World?[/u][/b]
[b]This New World Will Be Beach & Sea Themed And Will Be The New World 2 Connecting The Gap Between The Field / Jungle And Desert, This World Will Main Focus On Physics With Water And Summer / Sea Like Themed Obstacles And Enemy's[/b]

[b][u]Why Is This New World Being Added?[/u][/b]
[b]Due To Kaz's Adventure's Development Going So Well We Decided To Take Advantage Of Extra Time And Add More Worlds Originally Planned For Kaz's Adventure, Originally There Was Going To Be 8 Worlds But We Had To Limit It To Just 4 Due To Budget And Other Reasons Out Of The 4 Worlds Cut We Decided To Re Add The Beach Type World Thinking The Theme Can Make A Smoother Transition Between The Original World 1 And 2 In Terms Of Themes[/b]

[b][u]Is This World Part Of The Story Or Something Else?[/u][/b]
[b]This World Is The Same As Any Of The Other 4 Worlds By Being Story Related And In The Base Game, This Is Not Paid Or Free DLC Or Post Game Or Post Launch Content[/b]

[b][u]New World Ordering[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] World 1 | Jungle / Field
[*] World 2 | Beach / Sea
[*] World 3 | Desert / Cave
[*] World 4 | Volcanic Environment / Lava Fortress
[*] World 5 | Spaceship / Outer Space
[/list]
[b][u]Will It Change The Game Externally? (Pricing, Release Date Etc)[/u][/b]
[b]The Base Games Pricing Will Continue To Be Free And Will Never Change Even With The New World Being Added, The Release Date Is Still September 16th 2022[/b]
